qa_pairs.instruction: How do you upgrade the Delimited Text driver in Identity Manager?
qa_pairs.output: The upgrade process for the Delimited Text driver follows the same procedure as other Identity Manager drivers. For detailed instructions, refer to the 'Upgrading the Identity Manager Drivers' section in the NetIQ Identity Manager Setup Guide for Linux or the NetIQ Identity Manager Setup Guide for Windows, depending on your platform.

qa_pairs.instruction: Is the upgrade procedure for the Delimited Text driver different from other Identity Manager drivers?
qa_pairs.output: No, the upgrade procedure for the Delimited Text driver is the same as for other Identity Manager drivers. The standard Identity Manager driver upgrade process documented in the Setup Guides applies to the Delimited Text driver.
